# validate_call cannot handle parameters annotated with None

### Description

When using `validate_call` on a function that has a parameter annotated with `None` (e.g., `foo: None`), Pydantic fails to generate a schema for the function:
```python
>>> @validate_call
... def foo(bar: None):
...     pass

Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "[...]/.venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages/IPython/core/interactiveshell.py", line 3577, in run_code
    exec(code_obj, self.user_global_ns, self.user_ns)
  File "<ipython-input-2-25fd88474159>", line 4, in <module>
    @validate_call
     ^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "[...]/.venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages/pydantic/validate_call_decorator.py", line 110, in validate_call
    return validate(func)
           ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "[...]/.venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages/pydantic/validate_call_decorator.py", line 104, in validate
    validate_call_wrapper = _validate_call.ValidateCallWrapper(
                            ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "[...]/.venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages/pydantic/_internal/_validate_call.py", line 72, in __init__
    schema = gen_schema.clean_schema(gen_schema.generate_schema(function))
                                     ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "[...]/.venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages/pydantic/_internal/_generate_schema.py", line 612, in generate_schema
    schema = self._generate_schema_inner(obj)
             ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "[...]/.venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages/pydantic/_internal/_generate_schema.py", line 886, in _generate_schema_inner
    return self.match_type(obj)
           ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "[...]/.venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages/pydantic/_internal/_generate_schema.py", line 977, in match_type
    return self._call_schema(obj)
           ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "[...]/.venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages/pydantic/_internal/_generate_schema.py", line 1845, in _call_schema
    arg_schema = self._generate_parameter_schema(name, annotation, p.default, parameter_mode)
                 ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "[...]/.venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages/pydantic/_internal/_generate_schema.py", line 1537, in _generate_parameter_schema
    assert field.annotation is not None, 'field.annotation should not be None when generating a schema'
AssertionError: field.annotation should not be None when generating a schema
```

This worked in Pydantic v2.9 and earlier, so it seems to have been introduced in v2.10. This came up in a unit test so I'm not sure anyone would actually do this in the wild, but it seemed worth noting.

Replacing the `None` annotation with `type(None)` fixes the issue, but seems unpythonic.

### Example Code

```Python
from pydantic import validate_call

@validate_call
def foo(bar: None):
    pass
```
